quote: Telepin Software announced Tuesday it has landed a deal with the National Wallet Company in Yemen to provide a mobile banking solution to support the mostly cash-based society.

Yemen, which the United Nations says is in the midst of the world’s worst humanitarian crisis as conflict in the Middle Eastern country escalates, is largely “underbanked,” meaning its citizens do not have widespread access to bank accounts and traditional financial services.
Telepin’s solution, however, creates a digital wallet accessible via mobile phones, even without the need for internet access. Customers can receive, load and send money through these e-wallets.
